'''Meenka''' was the [[City/Legends|city]] in which [[Kir Kanos]] briefly resided in [[13 ABY/Legends|13 ABY]], during the time he hunted down [[Lem Krarr]]. Before he could leave, [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] captured Kanos and brought him to the [[Restored Empire]].
